content.text:
* Continuous-time 1.2 V PMOS LDO with wide-swing mirror load
.subckt DUT VIN VOUT VSS VREF
RFB1 VOUT FB 20k
RFB2 FB VSS 20k
* Regulated-output-derived low-current bias
RB VOUT BN 60k
XNB BN BN VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=50 l=2 nf=1 m=1
XNT TAIL BN VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=100 l=2 nf=1 m=2
* NMOS differential error amplifier
XN1 ND FB TAIL VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=100 l=2 nf=1 m=4
XN2 GATE VREF TAIL VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=100 l=2 nf=1 m=4
XP1 PS1 ND VIN VIN sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=100 l=1 nf=1 m=4
XP2 PS2 ND VIN VIN sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=100 l=1 nf=1 m=4
* Wide-swing cascode mirror load
XPC1 ND BC PS1 VIN sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=100 l=1 nf=1 m=1
XPC2 GATE BC PS2 VIN sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=100 l=1 nf=1 m=1
XPCB BC BC VIN VIN sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=1 l=1 nf=1 m=1
XNCB BC BN VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=25 l=2 nf=1 m=1
* PMOS pass device
XPP VOUT GATE VIN VIN sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=100 l=0.15 nf=1 m=4
* Series lead compensation for ideal 100 nF to 1 uF output capacitors
RC GATE COMP 200k
CC COMP VOUT 80p
* Supply feedforward reduces high-frequency pass-device VSG modulation
CFF VIN GATE 5p
.ends DUT
